content.short: Etherspot SDK is an account abstraction SDK delivering frictionless Web3 UX.
content.description: Etherspot SDK is a multi-chain, self-custody smart contract wallet platform that helps dApps, games, and wallet developers deliver a simple, seamless Web3 user experience. It accelerates onboarding for new users and hides the complexities of blockchain operations behind an approachable interface. The solution relies on counter-factual smart contract wallets and a multi-chain relayer infrastructure to power these capabilities across supported networks.
